name: lossy-throttle
description: A bad but not blocking path: 60 ms delay, 1% loss and a 4 Mbit/s cap in each direction. Every family must still carry verified bytes.
analogue: Ordinary degraded mobile connectivity, and the mild end of Iran's bandwidth shaping at the TIC gateways. Model: netem on both censor interfaces; loss is independent per packet (no bursts), the same for every protocol.
